UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Public and workspace profile attributes for a registered user without raw PII.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

joinedAt.description: ISO date string when the user joined

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated

UserPrivateInfo.title: UserPrivateInfo
UserPrivateInfo.description: Isolated PII document storing sensitive user contact information.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the owner

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the PII record was created

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the PII record was last updated

Workflow.title: Workflow
Workflow.description: Custom multi-step media processing workflow managed on the server via /api/workflows.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the workflow creator

description.description: Optional summary of what the pipeline automates (0 to 500 characters)

steps.description: Ordered list of tool IDs (bounded to 1 to 10 steps, each 1-64 chars matching ^[a-zA-Z0-9_\-]+$)

estimatedSavedSec.description: Estimated seconds saved per run (0 to 86400)

createdAt.description: Server epoch timestamp in milliseconds of creation

updatedAt.description: Server epoch timestamp in milliseconds of last update

ActivityLog.title: ActivityLog
ActivityLog.description: Audit log item recording a completed tool or workflow execution for a user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

toolTitle.description: Title of the executed tool or workflow

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the log entry was created

Entitlement.title: Entitlement
Entitlement.description: Server-managed subscription entitlement record for a user.

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user

endsAt.description: Optional epoch timestamp in milliseconds when a cancelled subscription ends

updatedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds of last server update

createdAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when entitlement was created

ProcessedWebhook.title: ProcessedWebhook
ProcessedWebhook.description: Server-only idempotency record for processed billing webhook events.

eventId.description: Webhook ID or SHA-256 digest of raw payload

uid.description: Firebase Auth UID affected by the webhook

processedAt.description: Epoch timestamp in milliseconds when event was claimed

/users/{userId}.description: Stores workspace profile and active subscription tier for each user.

/users/{userId}/private/{docId}.description: Stores isolated PII (email and phone) accessible strictly by the document owner.

/entitlements/{userId}.description: Stores server-managed billing entitlements readable only by the user and writable exclusively by Firebase Admin.

/workflows/{workflowId}.description: Stores custom user-created multi-step media workflows readable only by the owner and writable exclusively by the server via /api/workflows.

/activityLogs/{logId}.description: Stores per-user tool execution history logs.

/processedWebhooks/{webhookId}.description: Server-only billing webhook idempotency ledger with all client reads and writes denied.
